summary: Milestone verification of Creative Threshold hero + motion + full site. Backend: 13/13 pytest passed after updating tests to read ADMIN_PASSWORD from env (see credentials note). Frontend: hero-section, hero-pillars (CREATE→COLLABORATE→DEVELOP→PROPEL), two-line headline 'A New Category of / Creative Education.', ANCR/CCDP body copy, and 'Build the work. Own the future.' all render. Motion is ACTIVE: 7 SVGs / 41 paths inside hero-section with 17 framer-motion inline transform/opacity elements. Under prefers-reduced-motion (emulate_media), hero still renders a complete static visual (7 SVGs / 36 paths, correct bbox). Full CCDP logo (wordmark + emblem + 'CONTEMPORARY CREATIVE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM' + 'CREATE · COLLABORATE · DEVELOP · PROPEL') is visible in the header at desktop, tablet, and mobile without clipping. All 7 nav items render + 'Schedule a Briefing' CTA. hero-deck-btn opens InquiryDialog, form submit returns 200 with 'Welcome/Thank you' success (verified via new inquiry 'TEST_ Motion Org' visible in admin dashboard). hero-briefing-btn opens Google Calendar in a new tab (by design, schedulingUrl configured). Responsive layouts clean at 1920x1080, 768x1024, and 390x844; no overlap between hero CTAs (y=699-747) and the bottom-left music toggle (y=782). Admin login works and /admin/inquiries dashboard loads 6 existing records with stats (New 5, Contacted 1). Home page contains Global Adoption, Mentorship, Leadership, Danielle, and ANCR sections. No console errors captured.
action_items: DOC MISMATCH (P1): /app/memory/test_credentials.md lists admin password 'CCDP-Admin-ZrpB6xUAWcocsQXq' but the seeded/working admin password from /app/backend/.env is 'QnCggaMbqI4PjUl8XiisRrhW'. Login with the documented password returns 401. Either (a) update test_credentials.md to reflect the real .env password, or (b) rotate ADMIN_PASSWORD in backend/.env to the documented value and restart backend so seed_admin re-hashes it. Currently the tester had to fall back to the .env value to complete auth tests.
critical_code_review_comments: seed_admin() in /app/backend/auth.py correctly rotates the hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (line 64-66) — good. But this means whoever last edited backend/.env determines the working credentials; keep test_credentials.md in lockstep.
Hero motion is well-guarded by useReducedMotion — reduced-motion path renders 36 static paths (no crash, no blank area). Nice.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 inquiry via UI: TEST_ Motion Org / TEST Verify / QA / University / Executive Briefing (visible in admin dashboard). Backend tests also created several TEST_ inquiries via /api/inquiries. Existing CRM data NOT mutated (read-only admin check).
test_credentials: Working admin: danielle@aweday.org / QnCggaMbqI4PjUl8XiisRrhW (from backend/.env ADMIN_PASSWORD). The password documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md ('CCDP-Admin-ZrpB6xUAWcocsQXq') is stale and returns 401.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test uses os.environ.get('ADMIN_PASSWORD', '<fallback>'); if the admin pw is rotated, either update .env before running pytest (env is exported from backend/.env by pytest? no — you must export it) or update the fallback. rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no defects found. Only a credentials-doc drift between /app/memory/test_credentials.md and /app/backend/.env ADMIN_PASSWORD, which causes any tester/CI relying on the documented password to hit 401.
